title: My new friend Ken
instructions: Ada yeni arkadaşı Ken'i anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; ülke, yaş ve ortak hobilere dikkat et.

script.speaker: ada
script.text: I have a new friend at school. His name is Ken.

script.speaker: ada
script.text: He is from Japan, but now he lives in my street.

script.speaker: ada
script.text: Ken speaks Japanese and English. He is teaching me some Japanese words.

script.speaker: ada
script.text: We both love drawing. After school, we draw comics together.

script.speaker: ada
script.text: Ken has a little sister. Her name is Yumi, and she is six.

script.speaker: ada
script.text: Next week, Ken's mum is going to cook Japanese food for me.

questions.prompt: What do Ada and Ken both love?

questions.feedback: Ken'in kız kardeşi Yumi altı yaşında. On iki Ken ile Ada'nın yaşı.
